intro.text: A kickboxing club in Klagenfurt for people who want to train properly. Kids from five, adults of every level. Technique first, respect always — and a team that has your back.

disciplines.lead: From your first step on the mat to fight night.

items.name: K1
items.description: Explosive ruleset striking — punches, kicks, knees. Competition-ready training.

items.name: Kickboxing
items.description: Technique, power and conditioning. From first pads to fight night.

items.name: Muay Thai
items.description: The art of eight limbs — clinch, elbows and devastating kicks.

items.name: Boxing
items.description: Hand speed, footwork and defense. Sharpen the fundamentals.

items.name: Self-defense

coaches.label: Coaches
coaches.title: Meet your corner
coaches.lead: Experienced, demanding, and always in your corner.

items.name: Coach Buza
items.bio: Leads the pad work and fight preparation. Technique first, then power — every round has a purpose.

items.name: Erik
items.bio: Brings the youngest fighters into their first gloves with patience, fundamentals and a lot of fun.

items.title: Technique first
items.text: Clean fundamentals before power. Every session builds on the last.

items.title: Respect always
items.text: For coaches, partners and the mat. Beginners and fighters train side by side.

items.title: Real discipline
items.text: Show up, work hard, improve. Kids and adults learn the same lesson.
